Filed by Claude (head, session 8, claudex opus) from two #878 lanes that stopped on the brief's guard condition.

## What

Two Postgres suites skip on an env var that is not `OPENBRAIN_TEST_DATABASE_URL`, so the `requireTestDatabaseUrl()` swap does not fit them. Both are the same class of false green #878 targets, and both need the runner to provide what they ask for.

- `scripts/local-clone.test.ts:457-459` — `describe.skipIf(!process.env.OPENBRAIN_LOCAL_CLONE_TEST_DATABASE_URL)`. The suite asserts the URL points at `127.0.0.1`/`::1`, a database named `open_brain_local_*`, and the role `open_brain_local_clone`, then calls `productionDependencies.database.prove(...)` read-only. CI already exports it (`.github/workflows/ci.yml:231`, role and database created at `:132-134`, `:217`); `bun run test:isolated` does not.
- `scripts/retire-collab-migration.test.ts:172-175` — `dbDescribe = (OPENBRAIN_SCRATCH_ADMIN_URL ?? OPENBRAIN_SCRATCH_DATABASE_URL) ? describe : describe.skip`. The suite needs an admin connection that can `CREATE DATABASE` / `DROP DATABASE ... WITH (FORCE)`; it creates `ob_retire_collab_scratch_<ts>`, migrates it, seeds, and drops it. Eight of its tests (the whole live half) skip today.

## Ruling that applies

Rico, 2026-08-26 (#878): every Postgres test runs against a real database, and skipping is a hard failure. That settles the direction; what is left is mechanics.

## Plan (one lane each, in this order)

1. `scripts/test-isolated.ts` exports `OPENBRAIN_SCRATCH_ADMIN_URL` (it already holds admin credentials: it runs `createdb`/`dropdb`) and creates the `open_brain_local_clone` role plus an `open_brain_local_<name>` database the same way `ci.yml:132-134,217` does, exporting `OPENBRAIN_LOCAL_CLONE_TEST_DATABASE_URL`, and drops both on exit. Done-means: a script that runs `bun run test:isolated -- --help`-equivalent and asserts both vars are set in the child, RED on today's runner.
2. `scripts/test-support/require-test-database.ts` gains `requireLocalCloneTestDatabaseUrl()` and `requireScratchAdminUrl()` with the same throw shape (`test_database_required: <VAR> is unset; run bun run test:isolated`).
3. The two files convert with the matching helper, whole file to standard, manifest entries added, and `878-pg-tests-require-database.sh` clause 1 widened to name the two new vars alongside `OPENBRAIN_TEST_DATABASE_URL`.

Until 1 lands, the two files stay as they are; converting them first would make every local run fail on a missing var the runner does not supply.
